title: Skyblock Ascended
body:
##  Skyblock Ascended is a Modpack made for the Skyblock game mode on Hypixel.net
### Disclaimer
>  All of the included mods are client-side. They do not provide you with any unfair advantage, but merely improve you gameplay.
 
- This modpack Provides a collection of mods that optimize your Hypixel Skyblock experience through improved performance, practical UI adjustments, and useful quality-of-life features like Drop Tracker.

- Essential performance mods like Sodium, FerriteCore, Lithium and more. which prevent FPS drops.
- GUIs can be individually customized by the Player.
- Practical features for quickly sorting (Firmament) and filtering items (REI).
- The modpack comes with some useful Texture Packs, to make the Experience more comfortable.
- Modpack also aimed to make the game more enjoyable and fun with some achievements to grind. 
<details>
<summary>Mods for achievments</summary>

- Sbo: Diana achievements
- rfu: Fishing achievements
- skyhanni: some overall achievements
- Scatha-Pro: Something for Scatha mining

</details>
